# nuthatch nest on arbitrum-one

A self-hosted blockchain index. Query it locally; there is no third-party API.

## Contracts
- `subgraph_service` = 0xb2bb92d0de618878e438b55d5846cfecd9301105
- `curation` = 0x22d78fb4bc72e191c765807f8891b5e1785c8014
- `epochs` = 0x5a843145c43d328b9bb7a4401d94918f131bb281
- `disputes` = 0x2fe023a575449acb698648ed21276293fa176f96

## Tables (one per contract event)
- `curation__burned` - Burned(address,bytes32,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, curator, subgraphDeploymentID, tokens, signal)
- `curation__signalled` - Signalled(address,bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, curator, subgraphDeploymentID, tokens, signal, curationTax)
- `disputes__dispute_accepted` - DisputeAccepted(bytes32,address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, disputeId, indexer, fisherman, tokens)
- `disputes__dispute_cancelled` - DisputeCancelled(bytes32,address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, disputeId, indexer, fisherman, tokens)
- `disputes__dispute_drawn` - DisputeDrawn(bytes32,address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, disputeId, indexer, fisherman, tokens)
- `disputes__dispute_linked` - DisputeLinked(bytes32,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, disputeId1, disputeId2)
- `disputes__dispute_rejected` - DisputeRejected(bytes32,address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, disputeId, indexer, fisherman, tokens)
- `disputes__indexing_dispute_created` - IndexingDisputeCreated(bytes32,address,address,uint256,address,bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, disputeId, indexer, fisherman, tokens, allocationId, poi, blockNumber, stakeSnapshot, cancellableAt)
- `disputes__legacy_dispute_created` - LegacyDisputeCreated(bytes32,address,address,address,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, disputeId, indexer, fisherman, allocationId, tokensSlash, tokensRewards)
- `disputes__query_dispute_created` - QueryDisputeCreated(bytes32,address,address,uint256,bytes32,bytes,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, disputeId, indexer, fisherman, tokens, subgraphDeploymentId, attestation, stakeSnapshot, cancellableAt)
- `epochs__epoch_length_update` - EpochLengthUpdate(uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, epoch, epochLength)
- `epochs__epoch_run` - EpochRun(uint256,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, epoch, caller)
- `subgraph_service__allocation_closed` - AllocationClosed(address,address,bytes32,uint256,bool) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, indexer, allocationId, subgraphDeploymentId, tokens, forceClosed)
- `subgraph_service__allocation_created` - AllocationCreated(address,address,bytes32,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, indexer, allocationId, subgraphDeploymentId, tokens, currentEpoch)
- `subgraph_service__allocation_resized` - AllocationResized(address,address,bytes32,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, indexer, allocationId, subgraphDeploymentId, newTokens, oldTokens)
- `subgraph_service__indexing_rewards_collected` - IndexingRewardsCollected(address,address,bytes32,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes32,bytes,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, indexer, allocationId, subgraphDeploymentId, tokensRewards, tokensIndexerRewards, tokensDelegationRewards, poi, poiMetadata, currentEpoch)
- `subgraph_service__legacy_allocation_migrated` - LegacyAllocationMigrated(address,address,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, indexer, allocationId, subgraphDeploymentId)
- `subgraph_service__query_fees_collected` - QueryFeesCollected(address,address,address,bytes32,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, serviceProvider, payer, allocationId, subgraphDeploymentId, tokensCollected, tokensCurators)

## Live HTTP API (run `nuthatch dev`)
- `GET /`                    index status
- `GET /tables`              every table with its columns
- `GET /table/{name}?limit=N` recent rows of one table (hot + sealed)
- `GET /entity/{id}`         one row by id (`{block:012}-{logindex:06}`)
- `GET /sql?q=SELECT...`     read-only SQL; each table is a view named `{alias}__{event}`
- `GET /balances?limit=N`    top holder balances (when an ERC-20 Transfer table is present)
- `GET /balance/{address}`   one address's derived balance

## MCP (for coding agents)
Run `nuthatch mcp` (stdio) to expose tools: status, schema, tables, table, sql, entity,
balance, top_balances. Fully offline against the local instance; nothing phones home.
